q2_gaps: a standing deontic norm whose bearer is a specific INDIVIDUAL rather than a kind ("The Council must approve any station transfer"): the instruction set supplies only the kind-level reified property `(Inheritance <kind> (obligated <action>))` and the specific one-off event form `(Obligated e)`, leaving `(Member <individual> (obligated <action>))` — which this parse uses — unlicensed either way

the universal determiner "any" over the object of a kind-level deontic: it is absorbed into the compound action's `Patient` slot, and the instruction set gives no ruling on whether such a consumed quantifier word still owes a `QuantifierPhrase` companion (whose stated range would then appear nowhere else in the parse)
notes: Meaning is captured correctly, and the internals are per spec: "the Council" as a capitalized common-noun label with no `Name` atom, the compound-action decomposition of `approve_station_transfer` (genus + `Patient`), the `station_transfer` genus with the noun modifier unexposed, and the plain-norm TV 1.0/0.99. `Member` (not `Inheritance`) is the right relation for a property of the `sk_council_1` individual, so the encoding is at least internally consistent with the individual/class discipline.
